statement: Let (M, d, m) be a full-support RCD(K, N) space, where K ∈ R and 1 < N < ∞. Let F be bounded and globally Lipschitz, and let G be bounded and continuous. Suppose that for every compactly supported g ∈ Test(M) and every nonnegative h ∈ Lipc(M), HF (∇g, ∇g)(h) ≤ Z hG|∇g|2 dm, (6.1) where the weak Hessian is defined by (2.4). Then every constant-speed minimizing geodesic σ : [0, 1] → M, of length ℓ, satisfies (F ◦ σ)′′ ≤ ℓ2 G ◦ σ in distributions on (0, 1). (6.2)
